description: MATLAB Code: Topology optimization of stability-constrained structures with simple/multiple eigenvalues is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Kapil Khandelwal, University of Notre Dame (nd.edu). This work provides topology optimization framework for designing structures with linear buckling constraints wherein eigenvalues of arbitrary multiplicities can be canonically considered. Archived in this data depot is the computational codes used in the manuscript titled: "Topology optimization of stability-constrained structures with simple/multiple eigenvalues”. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 1 top-level file (ZIP). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-pxeh-ma28. Keywords: topology optimization, linear buckling constraints, structural stability. Published 2025-04-23. Facility named: Center for Research Computing, University of Notre Dame. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 3-Clause BSD License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
